independence: Reads original packed NetCDF with automatic decoding off. Uses offline SciPy face labeling and Decimal spherical-shell integration. Does not import app science, adapters or stores.

method.connectivity: six faces; no edge/corner connections or wrapped boundaries
method.threshold: inclusive finite lower/upper comparisons on decoded native float64
method.depth: inclusive native centers, then positive midpoint-bin overlap clipped to the selected depth window
method.volume: project estimate from midpoint bins, endpoint bounds at outermost centers, exact spherical-shell integral; no provider cell-boundary claim
method.membership_sha256: ascending global C-order flat indices serialized as little-endian int64
method.transect: straight lon/lat segment; evenly spaced stations; closest native column by spherical great-circle distance; original depth levels; no interpolation
